name: web-robot-hand-holding-glowing-ai-marketing-icon-cluster
title: A robotic hand holding a glowing blue signal icon surrounded by a floating cluster of marketing tool icons
whatItIs: A photo-real white composition with a white robotic hand rising from the bottom holding a glowing blue broadcast-signal icon, surrounded by a loose cluster of small line icons (chart, laptop, megaphone, calendar, people) connected by thin lines, with a blurred plant leaf in the corner.
whatItMeans: Clean and futuristic; the robot hand physically 'holding' abstract data makes AI feel tangible and in control.
techniques: Have a robotic hand physically grasp an abstract concept icon.
Cluster small related icons loosely around a glowing focal point.
Keep the background pure white so the icon cluster reads clearly.

vocabulary.definition: Several small icons grouped loosely around a central idea.
A glowing highlight marking the most important element.
